title: mentha sylvestris subsp. calliantha
intro: Mentha sylvestris subsp. calliantha, commonly known as Corn Mint, is a subspecies of mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Corn Mint are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include menthone, limonene, and carvone, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Corn Mint have been shown to have a range of beneficial effects, including reducing pain, improving respiratory function, and modulating the immune system.
